import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    
    static long powMod(long base, long power, long mod) {
        long r = 1;
        while (power > 0) {
            if ((power & 1) == 1) r = (r * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            power >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            long p = scanner.nextLong();
            long k = scanner.nextLong();
            
            if (k == 0) {
                System.out.println(powMod(p, p - 1, MOD));
                continue;
            }
            if (k == 1) {
                System.out.println(powMod(p, p, MOD));
                continue;
            }
            
            boolean[] bs = new boolean[(int)p];
            long pow = 0;
            
            for (long i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                if (bs[(int)i]) continue;
                long j = i;
                long w = 0;
                while (!bs[(int)j]) {
                    w++;
                    bs[(int)j] = true;
                    j = (j * k) % p;
                }
                if (powMod(k, w, p) == 1) pow++;
            }
            
            System.out.println(powMod(p, pow, MOD));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
